basic_info.description: Experience the best Hayes Valley has to offer with this light-filled, spacious top-floor condo. This home features classic period details including soaring high ceilings, original pocket doors, crown molding, hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace with a marble surround. Modern upgrades include recessed lighting, new fixtures, stainless steel appliances, and a new in-unit washer/dryer. A large, flexible second family room/dining area opens to a well-appointed kitchen with large windows and abundant natural light. Additional highlights include a generously sized street-level storage room, a private front entry, central gas heating, and a back patio. Ideally located near Hayes Valley, Alamo Square, NOPA, and Japantown. Easy access to the 101/80 Fwys, the Market Street Corridor, & public transportation. Truly a must-see!
